All described mutations are projection rows. However, it never explicitly distinguishes these reporting corrections from re-sending payments/invoices or other original business actions, as the final part of this critical rubric criterion requires. It does not propose such repeated actions; this is an omitted boundary, not a wrong value or unsafe executed effect.
